text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s33","problem":"The Noem hero photo is a flat cartoon (dark rectangle, cream bar, pink block), so the whole 20..572px image area is red. It was flagged in earlier rounds and is still unfixed. No hero picture is listed for s33 or s13, so the real photo cannot be used.","fix":"Replace the cartoon with a neutral dark (#15171c) block at the same rect (x20, y201, w371, h371). Drop the cream and pink shapes. This lowers the contrast error, since the real photo is mostly dark with pink and skin tones."},{"element_id":"s13","problem":"The same flat cartoon hero at y200..571 makes the heatmap red across the photo.","fix":"Use the same neutral dark fill (#15171c) at x20, y200, w371, h371 and remove the cream and pink rectangles."},{"element_id":"s13.e39","problem":"The 'Test Ad' label is 20.2px high, but the real one is 9.5px high (y829, w54.5).","fix":"Set the box to height 9.5px at y829 with overflow hidden, so it is clipped by the screen bottom. Keep x178.7 and w54.5."},{"element_id":"s13.e26","problem":"The bold 'Bryon Noem' run sits at x288.9 with w85.8, but should be x284.6 with w87.2. The same applies to e27 (duplicate tag) at y660.2 and h19.1.","fix":"Move the bold run to x284.6, set its width to 87.2 and its height to 19.1. Since the letters are narrower, check the preceding text ' husband ' so the run starts 4px earlier, and apply letter-spacing about +0.15px to the bold text."},{"element_id":"s33.e26","problem":"'Bryon Noem' is at x288.9 w85.8 and should be x284.6 w87.2.","fix":"Shift it 4px left, make it 87.2 wide and 19.1 high. Check that the text before it, 'Six months after photos of her husband', ends about 4px earlier."},{"element_id":"s19.e29","problem":"The line ' season 35 air on Tuesdays...' is 352.4 wide and 41.6 high. It should be 348.2 wide and 43 high, starting at y754.3.","fix":"Narrow the text by about 1%. Use line-height 24.5px so the two lines total 43px, and start the box at y754.3."},{"element_id":"s19","problem":"The ad thumbnail is a flat brown-gold gradient. The real one is a leaf and ladder photo. No picture is listed for it, and the mock's draw does not match.","fix":"Draw a mottled orange-brown and olive block, roughly #b7862f with darker #3d4a2b patches, at the thumbnail rect (x32, y142, w60, h60) with radius 8px. Avoid the gradient."},{"element_id":"s05","problem":"The Temu ad thumbnail is flat blue/gray blocks and a flat red '$2.36'. The real one is a jacket collage with 'TEMU MEGA SALE' at the top. Article text is also 1px high: caption and bullets sit at y644 and y740 instead of 645 and 741.","fix":"Make the thumbnail a light collage (#e8e4dc background, navy #1c2a4a and gray blocks, dark red #b00 '$2.36' bold). Shift the caption, Key Points and bullet text down 1px. Shrink the bullet text so 'Amber Glenn and Pasha Pashkov scored high on' starts at x40."},{"element_id":"s33","problem":"The ad thumbnail shows five yellow padlocks on a dark background instead of the real four locks and a question mark. The 'ADVERTISEMENT' label is 4px too far right (x210 vs 206).","fix":"Draw four small yellow locks. Move 'ADVERTISEMENT' left 4px to be centered at x205."}],"summary":"All screens are close on layout: element positions are nearly all within 4px and every tap works. The biggest visible errors are the flat cartoon Noem hero on s33 and s13, and the placeholder ad thumbnails. This round should tone down the hero cartoon, fix the few misses (s13.e39, Bryon Noem, s19.e29), and shift text 1px."}
